title: An Efficient, Secure, and Low-Communication Vertical Federated Learning Approach

pse.problem: The patent addresses the issue of security and low efficiency in vertical federated learning, where different devices belong to the same user but have different characteristics.
pse.solution_function: The invention presents a method for efficient, secure, and low-communication vertical federated learning. It involves participants sending selected feature data with added noise that satisfies differential privacy to other participants, aligning the data using received feature data as labels, and training multiple models with the original held data at the same data index.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include participating devices that hold different characteristic data and add noise to it before transmission. There is also a process for aligning data using indices.
pse.solution_implementation: Steps include selecting features, adding noise, sending data with indices, aligning the data, using received feature data as labels, training multiple models, and predicting and filling labels when necessary. The method follows differential privacy principles.
pse.effect: The solution allows for more efficient and quicker complete training at a minimal accuracy loss compared to traditional vertical federated learning methods.
